title: WardenExecutionAuditEvent
description: Signed ECES event emitted for every Phase 2 sandbox write decision.

event_id.description: SHA-256 hash uniquely identifying this proof atom.

parent_event_id.description: Hash of the causal parent event in the execution DAG.

contract_hash.description: Hash of the active Warden contract or manifest governing this run.

endpoint.description: The Phase 2 local execution tool invoked.

authorized_scope.description: Exact paths or capability patterns authorized by the gateway.

decision.description: Outcome of the policy enforcement point gate check.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the input script or file payload.

delta_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the resulting state modification or diff; null on deny.

envelope_hash.description: Hash over canonical replay fields including tool schema, model version, and random seeds.

commit_seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number assigned by the recorder.

timestamp_rec.description: Authoritative timestamp assigned by the trace recorder clock.

signature.description: EUF-CMA signature of the event serialization signed by the gateway or recorder key.
